This Application has been filed for 
quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal

Indian Penal Code, 1860.

Latwal, learned Assistant Government 
Advocate for the respondent.

Government Advocate has sought three 
weeks’ time to file counter affidavit in the 
present fresh matter.
4. Time is granted.
5. List on 12.03.2026.
6. It is clarified that this Court has not 
passed any stay order/interim order in the 
present matter.
